heading: FY27 Returns: Earnings-Driven Focus on Large-Cap Stocks
tldr: Kotak Institutional Equities predicts FY27 market returns will primarily be driven by corporate earnings.
Large-cap stocks, which have lagged recently, are expected to regain investor attention.
This shift is attributed to their relatively lower earnings growth in previous quarters.
The market is anticipated to move towards fundamentals, valuing consistent profitability.
Investors may need to recalibrate their portfolios, potentially favouring stability and established businesses.
caption:
Heads up, investors! For the next few years, how much money companies actually *make* could be the biggest driver of stock market growth. After a quiet period, big, well-known companies (large-caps) might shine again. This means focusing on solid businesses with steady profits.
